note: 32 demographically neutral base profiles. Each is scored on the four VI-SPDAT domains and is stratified across the full 0-17 range so the set is not clustered in one triage band. Domain maxima follow the VI-SPDAT v2.0 single-adult structure: History 0-2, Risks 0-4, Socialization 0-6, Wellness 0-5. Verify subscale maxima against the OrgCode source document before running the study.

profiles.label: Recent eviction, employed
profiles.vignette: Lost housing three weeks ago after a rent increase; couch-surfing with a coworker. Working part-time, no health conditions, no emergency service use.

profiles.label: Long-term car dweller, employed
profiles.vignette: Homeless 14 months, sleeping in a car. Steady income from a full-time job; reports no health, safety, or legal concerns.

profiles.label: Shelter stay, informal work
profiles.vignette: In a shelter for just over a year. Earning money under the table; reports no activities outside of day-to-day survival.

profiles.label: Short episode, untreated infection
profiles.vignette: Homeless two months. One emergency room visit for an untreated infection and a pending civil fine from an old citation.

profiles.label: Repeat shelter stay, minor debt
profiles.vignette: In a shelter 18 months. One police contact this year; reports owing money to a former landlord.

profiles.label: No income, socially isolated
profiles.vignette: Homeless four months. No income, no fulfilling activities, and money owed to a family member, but reports no health or safety risks.

profiles.label: Newly homeless, managed conditions
profiles.vignette: Homeless five weeks. Manages a chronic physical condition and a mental health diagnosis, and takes all medication as prescribed.

profiles.label: Chronic episodes, otherwise stable
profiles.vignette: Homeless three years across five episodes, currently sleeping outdoors. One hospitalization in the past six months; otherwise stable.

profiles.label: Shelter, no income, hygiene barriers
profiles.vignette: In a shelter 13 months. One crisis-line call in the past six months. No income and difficulty maintaining basic hygiene.

profiles.label: Newly homeless, unmanaged health
profiles.vignette: Homeless six weeks. Untreated diabetes, a mood disorder, and inconsistent access to medication; reports no risk or income concerns.

profiles.label: Outdoors, violence and eviction record
profiles.vignette: Homeless two years across four episodes, sleeping outdoors. Attacked twice since becoming homeless, a pending eviction judgment, and no income.

profiles.label: Short episode, high social burden
profiles.vignette: Homeless seven weeks. No income, no daily activities, unable to manage basic needs, money owed to a dealer, and recently left an abusive household.

profiles.label: Frequent ER, unmet basic needs
profiles.vignette: Homeless 15 months. Three emergency room visits and one night in a holding cell; owes money; unable to consistently bathe or change clothes.

profiles.label: High-risk survival strategies
profiles.vignette: Homeless eight weeks, sleeping outdoors. Six emergency room visits in six months, a recent assault, an open warrant, and trading sex for shelter.

profiles.label: Chronic episodes, no income
profiles.vignette: Homeless four years across six episodes. One ambulance call; no income; no fulfilling activities; unmanaged high blood pressure.

profiles.label: Tri-morbid, unmedicated
profiles.vignette: Homeless 13 months. Liver disease, schizophrenia, and daily alcohol use together; not taking medication as prescribed.

profiles.label: Shelter, hospitalizations, court date
profiles.vignette: In a shelter 16 months. Two hospitalizations, a pending court date, no income, unable to meet basic needs, and an untreated mental health condition.

profiles.label: Maximum socialization burden
profiles.vignette: Homeless two years across four episodes. No income, no activities, cannot manage basic needs, owes several people money, left an abusive relationship, and has been tricked into unwanted work.

profiles.label: Outdoors, tri-morbidity
profiles.vignette: Homeless three years, currently outdoors. Assaulted once since becoming homeless; owes money; no income; co-occurring physical, mental health, and substance use conditions with inconsistent medication.

profiles.label: Crisis-heavy, coerced work
profiles.vignette: Homeless nine weeks. Eight emergency contacts in six months, a recent assault, an open charge, coerced into running drugs, no income, and unable to meet basic needs.

profiles.label: Frequent crises, co-occurring conditions
profiles.vignette: Homeless 14 months. Frequent emergency room use, a recent assault, an open charge, no income, no activities, and a mental health condition alongside substance use.

profiles.label: Long-term chronic, medication theft
profiles.vignette: Homeless five years across seven episodes. One crisis call; no income; unable to bathe regularly; living with HIV, PTSD, and opioid use; medications frequently stolen.

profiles.label: Outdoors, coercion and untreated illness
profiles.vignette: Homeless two years outdoors. Repeated emergency room and police contact, a pending charge, coerced into risky work, no income, no activities, unable to meet basic needs, and an untreated mental health condition.

profiles.label: Self-harm risk, tri-morbid
profiles.vignette: Homeless 20 months. Several hospitalizations and a suicide attempt this year; no income; owes money; left an abusive relationship; co-occurring conditions with medication not taken as prescribed.

profiles.label: Chronic outdoors, multiple domains
profiles.vignette: Homeless four years across five episodes, outdoors. Frequent emergency service use, a recent assault, an open charge, no income, no activities, unable to meet basic needs, and a chronic physical condition with a mental health diagnosis.

profiles.label: High emergency use, tri-morbid
profiles.vignette: Homeless 18 months. Ten emergency contacts in six months, assaulted twice, coerced into running drugs, an open charge, no income, no activities, co-occurring conditions, and medications often stolen.

profiles.label: Long chronic history, fled abuse
profiles.vignette: Homeless six years across eight episodes. Repeated hospitalization, money owed to several people, no income, no activities, cannot meet basic needs, fled an abusive household, co-occurring conditions, and not taking medication.

profiles.label: Survival sex work, untreated illness
profiles.vignette: Homeless three years outdoors. Twelve emergency contacts, a recent assault, a threat to self-harm, a pending felony charge, trading sex for shelter, no income, cannot meet basic needs, and untreated mental illness with substance use.

profiles.label: Near-maximum across domains
profiles.vignette: Homeless five years across six episodes, outdoors. Frequent emergency room, ambulance, and jail contact; repeated assaults; open charges; coerced work; no income; no activities; unable to bathe; money owed; co-occurring conditions with unmanaged medication.

profiles.label: Severe chronic, all domains high
profiles.vignette: Homeless seven years, chronically outdoors. Constant emergency service use, repeated assaults, a suicide attempt, open charges, coerced into risky work, no income, no activities, unable to meet basic needs, fled abuse, co-occurring conditions, and medications routinely stolen.

profiles.label: Near-ceiling score
profiles.vignette: Homeless nine years across more than ten episodes. Constant emergency and police contact, repeated violence, coercion, no income or support network, complete inability to meet basic needs, and co-occurring conditions with inconsistent treatment.

profiles.label: Maximum score
profiles.vignette: Homeless 11 years, chronically outdoors. Scores the maximum on every domain: constant crisis service use, repeated assaults and self-harm, open charges, coerced survival work, no income or support, total inability to meet basic needs, and severe co-occurring conditions with no medication access.
